recommendations.title: Build 'best / vs / alternative' comparison pages
recommendations.why: Comparison queries are high-intent and disproportionately surfaced in AI answers.
recommendations.fix: Create objective comparison pages targeting your category's buying queries.

recommendations.title: Route authority to priority pages with internal links
recommendations.why: A flat link graph starves your most important pages of authority.
recommendations.fix: Add contextual links from high-authority pages into priority hubs and money pages.

recommendations.title: Close topical depth gaps on core commercial topics
recommendations.why: Thin coverage loses to competitors on both classic search and AI answers.
recommendations.fix: Build topical hubs around high-value services and expand coverage to match search intent.

recommendations.title: Deploy structured data across core templates
recommendations.why: Schema makes your content machine-readable for both Google rich results and AI engines.
recommendations.fix: Add Organization, Product/Service, Article and Breadcrumb JSON-LD to the right templates.

recommendations.title: Restructure into clear topical hubs
recommendations.why: A coherent architecture compounds — every new page reinforces the foundation.
recommendations.fix: Define hub-and-spoke taxonomy with clean URLs and consistent internal pathways.

recommendations.title: Add FAQ sections with FAQPage schema
recommendations.why: FAQs map directly to the question-shaped queries AI engines answer.
recommendations.fix: Add genuine, intent-driven FAQs to core pages and mark them up with FAQPage.

recommendations.title: Publish definitions with DefinedTerm signals
recommendations.why: Engines need clean definitions to understand the entities in your space.
recommendations.fix: Create glossary/definition blocks for core terms and mark them with DefinedTerm.

recommendations.title: Structure how-to content into clear steps
recommendations.why: Step-structured procedures are easy for engines to extract and cite.
recommendations.fix: Convert procedural content into numbered steps with optional HowTo markup.

recommendations.title: Sharpen entity signals across the site
recommendations.why: If engines can't tell who you are, they won't cite you with confidence.
recommendations.fix: Standardize naming, about pages and on-page entity references site-wide.

recommendations.title: Add author bios, credentials and review signals
recommendations.why: Authorship and expertise are core trust inputs for both Google and AI engines.
recommendations.fix: Attach credentialed author bios and reviewer signals to substantive content.

recommendations.title: Cite primary sources in substantive content
recommendations.why: Well-sourced content is more trustworthy to cite than unsupported claims.
recommendations.fix: Reference primary data and authoritative sources where you make claims.

recommendations.title: Cover conversational question queries
recommendations.why: AI search is question-led; head-term-only content misses the real demand.
recommendations.fix: Map and answer how/why/what/vs questions around your core topics.

recommendations.title: Publish and maintain llms.txt
recommendations.why: llms.txt guides AI engines to your most important, citable content.
recommendations.fix: Create an llms.txt indexing key pages and keep it current as content ships.

recommendations.title: Expand structured-data coverage for AI
recommendations.why: Richer structured data improves machine understanding and citation odds.
recommendations.fix: Add interlinked entity schema (Organization, sameAs, Article, FAQ) across templates.

recommendations.title: Strengthen E-E-A-T signals
recommendations.why: Experience, expertise and trust are decisive inputs for AI source selection.
recommendations.fix: Surface real experience, credentials, reviews and trust markers on key content.

recommendations.title: Build brand entity in the knowledge graph
recommendations.why: Recognized entities are cited; unknown brands are skipped.
recommendations.fix: Establish Wikidata presence, consistent profiles and sameAs links to anchor the entity.

recommendations.title: Standardize AI-citable content blocks
recommendations.why: Consistent, quotable blocks make every page a citation candidate.
recommendations.fix: Template a reusable answer-block pattern and roll it across priority content.

recommendations.title: Tighten the mobile experience
recommendations.why: Mobile-first indexing means mobile UX is the experience that gets evaluated.
recommendations.fix: Fix tap targets, viewport and layout friction on key mobile templates.

recommendations.title: Add direct-answer blocks to money pages
recommendations.why: Answer engines lift concise, self-contained answers — bury them and you're invisible.
recommendations.fix: Place a 40–60 word direct answer near the top of each key page, then expand below.

recommendations.title: Establish a visible freshness cadence
recommendations.why: AI engines favor current sources and drop stale ones from answers.
recommendations.fix: Set an update cadence and surface 'last updated' dates on evergreen pages.

recommendations.title: Rewrite titles and descriptions for intent and CTR
recommendations.why: Metadata is the cheapest lever for click-through and intent alignment.
recommendations.fix: De-duplicate titles, align to primary intent, and write descriptions that earn the click.

recommendations.title: Improve heading hierarchy and extractability
recommendations.why: Clean structure with lists and tables is far easier for engines to quote.
recommendations.fix: Enforce logical H-tags and convert dense prose into lists and comparison tables.

recommendations.title: Confirm and allow AI crawler access
recommendations.why: Blocking AI crawlers guarantees zero AI citations — it's the first gate.
recommendations.fix: Explicitly allow GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot and Google-Extended in robots.txt.

recommendations.title: Improve crawl efficiency and directives
recommendations.why: Wasted crawl budget means slower discovery of your important content.
recommendations.fix: Clean robots.txt, fix crawl traps, and keep XML sitemaps lean and current.

recommendations.title: Resolve index coverage and free up crawl budget
recommendations.why: Pages that can't be indexed can't rank or be cited — this caps every other effort.
recommendations.fix: Audit noindex/robots rules and canonical logic; ensure priority templates are indexable and in the sitemap.
